mainGoal: Port the reusable CMS foundation (auth, db, media, cache, editor, workflow, ai placeholders, privacy, admin, public, preview) from the legacy Hono+TS Worker into the new standalone kodigital-homepages-cms Worker, satisfying all seven Phase 1 acceptance gates with no legacy production identifiers in active code.

stories.title: Initial CMS migration 0001_init_cms.sql with 11 tables and Phase-2 site_id TODO comments
acceptanceCriteria: Migration creates all 11 required tables (CREATE TABLE count >= 11 covering articles, article_versions, categories, tags, article_tags, pages, media, redirects, site_settings, prompt_presets, privacy_opt_outs)
Migration contains TODO Phase-2 site_id comment markers (>=1 per multi-tenant table)

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the new D1 binding kodigital-homepages-cms-db with no tables, WHEN `wrangler d1 migrations apply kodigital-homepages-cms-db --local` runs, THEN all 11 tables appear in the local sqlite file with the documented columns and indexes

stories.title: Typed D1 query helpers in api/src/db/index.ts (parameterized only)
acceptanceCriteria: All D1 calls use prepare(...).bind(...) — zero template-literal SQL interpolation in db/index.ts
Helper exposes typed exports: getArticleBySlug, listArticles, getMediaById, listCategories at minimum

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the new D1 helpers, WHEN getArticleBySlug("test") is called with a planted slug, THEN the row returns via prepare(...).bind(...) parameter binding (no template-literal interpolation anywhere in db/index.ts).

stories.title: Replace presence-check auth with full CF Access JWKS+RS256 validation in api/src/auth/access-auth.ts
acceptanceCriteria: auth module imports jose JWKS+jwtVerify and validates exp/nbf/iss/aud/email
JWKS cache key written to KV with expirationTtl 24h (86400 seconds)

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN APP_ENV=development AND DEV_BYPASS_AUTH=true, WHEN any /admin route is requested without a JWT, THEN the handler proceeds and returns the admin shell (200); GIVEN APP_ENV!=development OR DEV_BYPASS_AUTH unset, WHEN /admin is requested without a valid JWT, THEN response is 401
package.json adds jose as a dependency

stories.title: KV cache helper with feed-key invalidation + Cache API stub in api/src/cache/index.ts
acceptanceCriteria: Module exports cacheGet, cacheSet, cacheDel, invalidateFeeds
Cache API path gated by env.CACHE_API_ENABLED before any caches.default access

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN cacheSet("feed:rss", body) followed by invalidateFeeds(), WHEN cacheGet("feed:rss") is called, THEN it returns null (the invalidation deleted the key) — confirms KV roundtrip + invalidation behavior.

stories.title: Editor block engine + sanitizer (7 block types, hand-rolled allowlist) in api/src/editor/
acceptanceCriteria: blocks.ts handles exactly 7 block types: paragraph, heading, list, quote, image, divider, html (and rejects 'embed')

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN an editor JSON document containing an html block with <script>alert(1)</script>, WHEN contentJsonToHtml is called, THEN the rendered HTML contains no <script> tag and no on* attribute and no javascript: URL
Image blocks default to loading="lazy" unless data.aboveTheFold is true

stories.title: Publish workflow state machine + version snapshot + feed invalidation in api/src/workflow/
acceptanceCriteria: State transition table enumerates the legal pairs: draft->published, draft->scheduled, scheduled->published, scheduled->draft, published->archived, published->draft

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN an article in draft with content_json blocks, WHEN publish() is called, THEN (a) article_versions row is inserted with snapshotted content_json, (b) articles.content_html is set to the rendered HTML, (c) articles.status='published' and published_at is set, (d) invalidateFeeds is called once

stories.title: Privacy module: SHA-256(IP+UA), opt-out cookie, public unauthenticated routes in api/src/privacy/
acceptanceCriteria: Privacy module uses Web Crypto subtle.digest('SHA-256', ...) for the IP+UA hash

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN no ccpa_opt_out cookie set, WHEN POST /api/privacy/opt-out is called with IP=1.2.3.4 UA='ua/1', THEN response 200 sets Set-Cookie ccpa_opt_out=1 AND a privacy_opt_outs row exists keyed by sha256('1.2.3.4|ua/1')
All three privacy routes (/api/privacy/status, /api/privacy/opt-out, /api/privacy/opt-in) declared

stories.title: Media serve + upload with R2 ETag and 1y immutable Cache-Control in api/src/media/
acceptanceCriteria: GET /media/* response sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a mocked R2 binding returning httpEtag='abc123' for key foo.png, WHEN GET /media/foo.png is called, THEN response 200 has ETag header == 'abc123' AND Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable AND Content-Type matches the R2 metadata

stories.title: Public router + reserved-path guard + feeds (RSS/Atom/sitemap/robots/ads) in api/src/public/
acceptanceCriteria: Reserved path list contains exactly admin, api, static, assets, media, preview, health (7 entries)

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN no published page row with slug='admin', WHEN GET /admin is requested, THEN the request is routed to the admin handler (NOT the /:slug compatibility placeholder) — proven by response Content-Type or admin-specific marker
Public router declares all 12 required routes

stories.title: Admin router + CRUD/workflow/AI placeholder APIs in api/src/admin/
acceptanceCriteria: Admin shell GETs declared for /admin, /admin/articles, /admin/pages, /admin/categories, /admin/tags, /admin/media, /admin/settings, /admin/presets
AI endpoints return 501 unless OPENAI_API_KEY is set
Admin auth-status route declared at /api/admin/auth/status

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN admin router mounted, WHEN GET /api/admin/articles is called without CF Access JWT, THEN response is 401; WITH DEV_BYPASS_AUTH=true, response is 200 with an empty list payload; AND POST /api/admin/ai/generate-text returns 501 when OPENAI_API_KEY is unset.

stories.title: Preview route with HMAC-signed short-lived tokens in api/src/preview/
acceptanceCriteria: Preview module uses Web Crypto HMAC (subtle.sign with HMAC) for token signing — no jose, no full JWT
Token payload encodes articleId, versionId, exp

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN preview HMAC secret PREVIEW_SECRET set, WHEN GET /preview/<articleId> is called with a valid signed token (matching articleId+versionId+exp), THEN response is 200 rendering the draft content; WITH a tampered or expired token, response is 401.

stories.title: Wire all routers into api/src/index.ts with reserved-path guard before /:slug
acceptanceCriteria: index.ts mounts all sub-routers (admin, public, privacy, media, preview)

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN wrangler dev running locally with DEV_BYPASS_AUTH unset, WHEN curl GET /health and curl GET /admin and curl GET /api/privacy/status, THEN /health returns 200 AND /admin returns 401 AND /api/privacy/status returns 200

stories.title: Extend assert-no-legacy-prod-refs.ts denylist with 5 legacy CMS identifiers
acceptanceCriteria: Denylist additions present: kodigital2.cloudflareaccess.com, admin.theiwise.com, legacy CF_ACCESS_AUD, legacy D1 id, legacy KV id
Verify script exits 0 against the current worktree (no banned identifiers in active code)
Shared account_id a05d7505b71c6cd931e436defe670509 is NOT added to the denylist (must remain allowed)
